weeks.title: 見面與介紹
weeks.subtitle: Meeting & Introductions
weeks.focus: be 動詞（am/is/are）、人稱代名詞、問句與否定句

grammar.explain: be 動詞（am/is/are）會依主詞不同而改變：I 用 am，He/She/It 用 is，You/We/They 用 are。否定句只要在 be 動詞後面加上 not（is not 可縮寫成 isn't，are not 可縮寫成 aren't），疑問句則是把 be 動詞移到句子最前面，再加上主詞。
patterns: I am a student.
She is not a teacher. (She isn't a teacher.)
Are you from Taiwan?
They are not busy. (They aren't busy.)

grammar.explain: 所有格（my、your、his、her、our、their）放在名詞前面，用來表示東西或家人是「誰的」，例如 my mother（我的媽媽）。動詞 have 用在 I、You、We、They 之後，has 用在 He、She 之後，用來表示「擁有」某位家人或某樣東西。this、that、these、those 用來指出人或物，this/that 接單數，these/those 接複數。
patterns: This is my father.
She has two brothers.
These are their children.
That is his car.

weeks.title: 日常作息
weeks.subtitle: Daily Routine & Present Simple
weeks.focus: 現在簡單式（肯定/否定/疑問）、第三人稱 -s、頻率副詞

grammar.explain: 現在簡單式用來描述習慣性動作或每天的例行事務。肯定句在第三人稱單數（he/she/it）動詞後要加 -s 或 -es；否定句用 don't 或 doesn't 加上原形動詞；疑問句則用 Do 或 Does 放在句首，主詞之後接原形動詞。
patterns: I get up at seven o'clock every day.
She doesn't drink coffee at night.
Do you go to work by bus?
He usually eats breakfast at home, but he never eats breakfast on Sundays.

weeks.title: 地方與方位
weeks.subtitle: Places & There is/are
weeks.focus: There is / There are、地方介系詞

grammar.point: There is / There are + 地方介系詞
grammar.explain: 「There is」用來表示某個地方「有」一個單數的人或物，「There are」則用於複數。否定句是在 is/are 後面加 not（isn't / aren't），疑問句則把 Is/There 或 Are/There 的順序對調，變成 Is there...? / Are there...?。地方介系詞（in, on, under, next to, between, near 等）用來說明東西或地方確切的位置。
patterns: There is a bed in the bedroom.
There are two chairs next to the table.
There isn't a car in the garage.
Is there a park near your house?

grammar.explain: 英文名詞分為可數名詞（countable，如 apple, egg，有單數與複數形式）與不可數名詞（uncountable，如 water, rice，沒有複數形式）。在肯定句與提出邀請時，我們常用 some（一些）；在否定句與疑問句中，則常用 any。要禮貌地表達「我想要」時，可以用 would like 加上名詞，例如 I would like some coffee.；詢問不可數名詞的數量用 How much，詢問可數名詞的數量則用 How many。
patterns: I would like some bread.
Do you have any milk?
How much water do you want?
How many apples do you have?

weeks.title: 過去的事
weeks.subtitle: Past Simple
weeks.focus: 過去簡單式（was/were、規則與常見不規則動詞）

grammar.explain: 過去簡單式用來說已經發生的事。be動詞用 was/were，一般動詞規則變化加 -ed，但很多常用動詞是不規則變化，要直接背下來。否定句用 didn't + 原形動詞，問句用 Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞，注意動詞要用原形，不能再加 -ed。
patterns: I was tired last night.
She watched TV yesterday.
He didn't go to school last week.
Did you eat breakfast this morning?

weeks.title: 未來計畫與能力
weeks.subtitle: Future Plans & Can
weeks.focus: be going to（未來計畫）、can/can't（能力）、邀約用語

grammar.explain: 「be going to + 原形動詞」用來表達已經決定的未來計畫，例如 I am going to study tomorrow.；「can / can't + 原形動詞」用來表達能力，說明會不會做某件事，例如 I can swim, but I can't ski.；邀約時可以用「Would you like to + 原形動詞?」有禮貌地詢問對方意願。
patterns: I am going to visit my parents next week.
She can speak English, but she can't speak French.
Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?
We are going to go hiking if the weather is sunny.

weeks.title: 總複習與自我檢測
weeks.subtitle: Review & Self-Check
weeks.focus: 綜合 be動詞／have-has／現在簡單式／there is-are／some-any／過去式／going to-can／問句與連接詞

grammar.point: 把前七週的文法放在一起總複習
grammar.explain: 這一週不學新文法，而是把 be 動詞、have/has、現在簡單式、there is/are、可數不可數與 some/any、過去簡單式、be going to／can、問句與連接詞全部混在一起練習，模擬真實情境下這些文法會交錯出現的樣子。
patterns: I am a student, and I have one brother.
I usually wake up at seven, but yesterday I woke up late.
I am going to visit my parents next week.

weeks.title: 補充週：現在進行式
weeks.subtitle: Present Continuous
weeks.focus: am/is/are + V-ing、否定、問句、與現在簡單式對比

grammar.point: 現在進行式：am / is / are + V-ing
grammar.explain: 描述「說話的此刻正在進行」或「這陣子暫時」的動作。be 動詞跟著主詞變（I am / he is / they are），後面接動詞加 -ing。否定在 be 後面加 not；問句把 be 移到句首。和現在簡單式比較：every day / usually 是習慣，用簡單式；now / right now / at the moment / Look! / Listen! 是正在發生，用進行式。
patterns: I am reading a book now.
She isn't sleeping. She's studying.
Are you working at the moment? — Yes, I am.
What are they doing? — They are playing basketball.
He usually drives to work, but today he is taking the bus.

There is a nice view from my window. Near my apartment, there is a supermarket and a small park. There is a bank between the park and the school. There isn't a restaurant near my house, but there is a good one near the station. My neighborhood is quiet and convenient.

reading.title: 短文 2
reading.text: I live in a small house with my family. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. There is a big sofa in the living room. The kitchen is behind the living room. There are three windows in the kitchen, so it is bright. There is a small garden behind the house. There are four trees in front of the house. My bike is behind the door. There isn't a garage, so I park my bike there. I like my house because it is quiet and warm.

reading.title: 短文 3
reading.text: My neighborhood is not big, but it is nice. There is a park near my house. There are two markets on my street. One market is next to my school. The school is between the park and the library. The library is in front of the station, so it is easy to find. There aren't any movie theaters in my neighborhood. There isn't a big hospital here, but there is a small clinic behind the post office. My neighborhood is quiet at night. I like it very much.

Where is the school?
opts: Between the park and the library

reading.text: Ken lives on the tenth floor. From his window he can see the whole street. There is a bus stop in front of his building. There are many bikes next to the bus stop. items.passage: Peter is a chef at a small restaurant in Tainan. He usually works from four o'clock until midnight, so he doesn't see his family very often. Last month, the restaurant was closed for two weeks, and Peter went to Hualien with his wife and daughter. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. There was a beach in front of the hotel, and every morning they swam before breakfast. Peter's daughter can't swim well, so she played in the sand. On the last day, they bought some tea and cookies for Peter's parents. Next year, Peter is going to open his own restaurant. His wife is going to help him, and his daughter would like to make the desserts.
